document.title: Clinic Booking Portal: Requirements v0.3
document.scope_note: All sections read. Emphasis on security, performance and data handling.

requirements.text: Patients can book an appointment with any available clinician.
The booking page must be fast.

measure.meter: Load test at the peak profile, p95 and max

requirements.text: Accounts are locked after five failed sign-in attempts.

ambiguities.heuristic: Mary had a little lamb (ER1 ch 9)

requirements.text: Patient records are kept in line with data protection law.
basis: EXT: UK GDPR Art 5(1)(e) storage limitation

questions.question: What response time for confirming a booking is acceptable at the Monday 8am peak, for 95% of bookings and for the slowest one?
questions.why: R-002 cannot be tested as written; percentile alone hides the tail (ER2 ch 21).

questions.question: Over what period are failed attempts counted, and how is a locked account unlocked?
questions.why: Lockout window and recovery path decide the boundary examples.

questions.question: How long must each kind of patient record be kept, and what happens at the end of that period?
questions.why: Retention is an imposition; its source and period decide the deletion scenarios.

scenarios.title: Booking - patient books an available slot
given: Dr Patel has a free slot at 10:00 on 3 March
then: the slot is no longer shown as free

scenarios.title: Sign-in - fifth consecutive failure locks the account

assumptions.text: Attempts are counted consecutively with no time window

given: an account with four consecutive failed sign-ins
scenarios.when: a fifth sign-in with the wrong password is attempted
then: a security event records the time and account

scenarios.title: Booking - confirmation time at Monday peak

assumptions.text: Peak is 400 concurrent patients; target p95 < 2 s, max < 10 s

measurement.metric: Seconds from Confirm to confirmation shown
measurement.load_profile: 400 concurrent users, 70% browse / 30% book, 15 min ramp, 1 h steady
measurement.environment: Pre-production sized like production, with a year of booking data
measurement.oracle: Load-tool percentiles; build fails if p95 regresses more than 2% on the previous run

scenarios.title: Data - records past retention are removed

assumptions.text: A retention period exists per record type

items: Explore records either side of the retention boundary to discover whether deletion happens on time and completely
Check backups, logs, search indexes and exports for residual copies

gaps.missing: No requirement on who may see another patient's appointments (authorisation).
gaps.why_it_matters: Loser groups: people who must be kept out need requirements too (ER1 ch 7).
